question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM male_la_legislators)
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
all_dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT CAST(year || '-12-31' AS DATE) as dec31
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(term_start AS DATE))::INTEGER as year
        FROM legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA'
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(term_end AS DATE))::INTEGER as year
        FROM legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA'
    ) years
),
serving_on_dec31 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ft.id_bioguide, ft.first_term_start, d31.dec31
    FROM first_terms ft
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ft.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN all_dec31_dates d31
    WHERE CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= d31.dec31 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= d31.dec31
),
with_years AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start, dec31,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(dec31, CAST(first_term_start AS DATE)))::INTEGER AS years_elapsed
    FROM serving_on_dec31
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(dec31, CAST(first_term_start AS DATE)))::INTEGER > 30 
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(dec31, CAST(first_term_start AS DATE)))::INTEGER < 50
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM with_years
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
